name: dsh-agentos-remote
description: WorkBuddy mobile-app remote control for DSH: implements WorkBuddy's AgentOS local-agent protocol (registerWorkspace + Centrifugo downlink + HTTP COPILOT_RESPONSE uplink) with built-in WeChat-QR login reachable from a sidebar panel in the DSH web client or the standalone /agentos-remote/login page — no WorkBuddy desktop required on the DSH host.

scripts.test: node test/load.test.mjs && node test/client.test.mjs && node test/device-auth.test.mjs && node test/conversation-sync.test.mjs && node test/envelope.test.mjs && node test/session-store.test.mjs && node test/runtime.test.mjs
